purpose: City-specific cadastral-source research; findings are limited to observed first-party evidence.
name: Niš

queries.query: Niš Serbia official cadastral parcel map RGZ geoportal
queries.result: First-party discovery identified the Republic Geodetic Authority (RGZ) cadastral-office/public-access pages and the official City of Niš GIS Smart Portal. The municipal GIS exposes an ArcGIS MapServer layer named Nis_NEP with polygon geometry and parcel/object classification; no successful anonymous feature response was obtained.

queries.query: Niš katastar parcela zvanični geoportal RGZ
queries.result: First-party Serbian-language RGZ results identify the Niš cadastral service/public eKatastar route. The official City of Niš GIS Smart Portal and Nis_NEP ArcGIS layer were also confirmed; no safe anonymous parcel geometry response was returned by the bounded probes.

registryEvidence.custodian: City of Niš GIS Smart Portal is a local first-party municipal GIS route; RGZ is the national cadastral custodian and lists the Niš cadastral office/service.
registryEvidence.locality: The GIS service is explicitly named Nis_NEP and is hosted under the City of Niš GIS domain. RGZ public-access material describes Serbia-wide cadastral search by cadastral municipality/parcel or address.
registryEvidence.scopeNote: The municipal service is evidence of a local first-party GIS/cadastral-style map route, not evidence that all cadastral records or all city parcels are publicly queryable or complete. RGZ is recorded as general/national agency context, not as a successful geometry integration route.

parcelDiscovery.nativeIdField: objectid (OID); metadata also exposes gis_id, deoparcele_id, brparcele and related source fields
parcelDiscovery.boundedResponse: No usable feature response; the service layer metadata was retrieved successfully, but anonymous /query probes returned an HTML error page or ArcGIS error 500.
parcelDiscovery.note: The official layer metadata reports esriGeometryPolygon and a parcel/object classification field. Because no bounded ID+geometry response was obtained, no GeoJSON was retained. Source-specific attributes, including potentially unsafe fields visible in the schema, were not requested for retention.

attempts.outcome: HTTP 200 viewer HTML retrieved; current page references the GDi Smart Portal JavaScript bootstrap. No login or credentials used.
HTTP 200; official ArcGIS service metadata retrieved. Service contains layer 0 Nis_NEP, polygon layer, service CRS EPSG:3857, and Map/TilesOnly capabilities.

HTTP 200; layer schema retrieved. Polygon geometry and safe candidate native identifier objectid were observed; metadata also exposed many non-safe descriptive/right-holder fields, which were not requested or retained.
No usable GeoJSON response; returned an HTML error page from the MapServer route. No feature or geometry retained.

HTTP 200 transport with ArcGIS JSON error code 500, Error performing query operation. This is an unusable query outcome, not evidence of a zero exact-point hit or citywide absence; the exact WUP point was preserved and not shifted.
Official RGZ public-access guidance retrieved; it describes public eKatastar search by parcel number within cadastral municipality or address, but no anonymous polygon API was exposed by this route.

uncertainty: The exact WUP point [43.3188198916352, 21.9103223663759] was preserved and never shifted.

The official local layer metadata demonstrates a municipal parcel/object map layer, but the current anonymous query route did not return usable features; this may reflect MapServer capability or route/query restrictions.
No zero-hit, extent miss, timeout, login wall, or unusable UI result is interpreted as citywide absence.
No owner, address, contact, titleholder, personal, tax, account, certificate, or other unsafe fields were requested or retained.
This packet is research evidence only and is not source integration or admission.
